banner.title: ArduDeck Beta 1.2 is dedicated to Sir Patrick Stewart, 1940 to 2026.
banner.body: For this release ArduDeck can wear a bridge theme in memory of Captain Picard. Every screen and instrument works as usual; Settings › Theme switches back at any time.

moment.legacy: As Captain Jean-Luc Picard he showed a generation that the best captains explore with curiosity, listen to their crew, and hold to their principles when it is hard.
moment.label: Dedication

theme.bridgeDescription: A dedication theme for this release. Dark, with the navigation rail as console blocks.
